user.title: Create an energy or power sensor
user.description: Create a sensor that adds and subtracts other energy or power sensors.

inputs_energy.title: Energy inputs
inputs_energy.description: Choose the energy sensors to add and subtract.

data_description.sum_entities: Sensors whose values are added to the total.
data_description.subtract_entities: Sensors whose values are subtracted from the total.
data_description.output_unit: Unit of measurement of the created sensor.
data_description.update_interval: 0 = recalculate every time an input changes. Otherwise recalculate every this many seconds (max 3600).
data_description.max_power: Optional. If an input's energy changes faster than this power (W), the jump is treated as an outlier (e.g. a replaced meter that reset to zero) and is offset so the total carries on from its previous value. Leave empty or 0 to disable.

inputs_power.title: Power inputs
inputs_power.description: Choose the power sensors to add and subtract.

data_description.sum_entities: Sensors whose values are added to the total.
data_description.subtract_entities: Sensors whose values are subtracted from the total.
data_description.output_unit: Unit of measurement of the created sensor.
data_description.update_interval: 0 = recalculate every time an input changes. Otherwise recalculate every this many seconds (max 3600).
data_description.outlier_threshold: Optional, in the output unit. When the calculated power is above this value (positive or negative), the sensor keeps its previous value instead. Leave empty or 0 to disable.

units.title: Input units

error.no_entities: Select at least one sensor to add or subtract.
error.duplicate_entities: A sensor cannot be in both the add and subtract lists.
error.unit_required: This sensor does not report a usable unit; select its unit explicitly.
